text: {"quantities": [{"id": "q1", "value": 3, "unit": "", "kind": "count", "span": "three times as old as his son"}, {"id": "q2", "value": 12, "unit": "years", "kind": "count", "span": "after 12 years"}, {"id": "q3", "value": 2, "unit": "", "kind": "count", "span": "twice the age of his son"}], "plan": [{"op": "mul", "args": ["q3", "q2"], "out": "s1", "note": "twice the number of years ahead"}, {"op": "sub", "args": ["s1", "q2"], "out": "s2", "note": "son's present age, from the future-age equation"}, {"op": "sub", "args": ["q1", "q3"], "out": "s3", "note": "difference between the two age multipliers"}, {"op": "div", "args": ["s2", "s3"], "out": "s4", "note": "son's present age"}, {"op": "mul", "args": ["q1", "s4"], "out": "s5", "note": "father's present age = three times the son's"}], "target": {"kind": "count", "scope": "the son's present age (the father's present age is three times this)"}, "dismissed": []}
